definitions.explanation: To a high degree; used to emphasize the extent of something.

examples.japanese: {大層|たいそう}お⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Thank you very much for your help.

examples.japanese: {大層|たいそう}⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{大層|たいそう}な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。

notes:
{大層|たいそう} means 'very' or 'greatly,' with a formal, slightly old-fashioned tone. It can also imply exaggeration.

USAGE:
- As adverb: {大層|たいそう}⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (very impressive)
- As na-adjective: {大層|たいそう}な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (say exaggerated things)
- Polite expression: {大層|たいそう}お⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧ (received great help)
When modifying nouns ({大層|たいそう}な〜), it often carries a nuance of 'exaggerated' or 'overblown,' sometimes with mild sarcasm: {大層|たいそう}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (what a grand story / that's a big claim).

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧ (gymnastics, physical exercise) — same reading, different kanji and meaning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very (neutral, common)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}に→非常に：01223_hijouni⟧: extremely (formal)
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧: very, greatly (more common in everyday speech)
- {大層|たいそう} sounds more literary or old-fashioned than these alternatives
